name: Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Umbara)
description: This battle droid was stationed on the bridge of a Separatist supply ship stationed above the planet of Umbara during the Battle of Umbara.

data.name: Unidentified B1-series battle droid
data.death: c. 21 BBY, aboard a Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel, over Umbara
